--- title: "Explorer" --- SMexplorer is a Shiny app that allows for interactive exploration of metrics, mostly at the county level. It includes a map page, a bivariate plot explorer to see relations between metrics, a county/state details page, and a metadata table much like what is included in this Quarto doc. You can find the code at the [SMexplorer GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Food-Systems-Research-Institute/SMexplorer). It tends to work best if you open it in its own page using the button below: ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: You can also just use it here in the window, but some features, like the full screen mode in the map page, will only work in a separate tab. Note that either way, there is a bit of a cold start-up time before the app gets running and becomes responsive.
